title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the functional study nooks, quiet lounges, and specialized labs that Case Western students use to navigate their rigorous academic schedules.

cards.title: Decompress in the KSL Zen Zone
cards.subtitle: Kelvin Smith Library
cards.notes: Take a mental break with puzzles, games, and mindfulness activities in this dedicated wellness space on the library's first floor.
cards.short_summary: A wellness-focused relaxation area within the Kelvin Smith Library featuring mindfulness tools.
cards.evidence_claim: The Zen Zone is a space for wellness and relaxation containing puzzles, games, and mindfulness activities.
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; accessible to students with a valid CWRU ID.

cards.entity_name: Peter B. Lewis Building Upper Floors
cards.title: Study in the Gehry-Designed Curves
cards.subtitle: Weatherhead School of Management
cards.notes: Navigate the fourth and fifth floors for quiet, sun-filled lounges and architectural nooks often overlooked by those on the lower levels.
cards.short_summary: Quiet study lounges located on the upper levels of the iconic Frank Gehry-designed business school building.
cards.evidence_claim: The fourth and fifth levels of the Peter B. Lewis Building are less inhabited and feature go-to study spots like the fourth-floor lounge.
cards.source_title: Hidden gems: Places to study off the beaten path
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; primarily used by Weatherhead students but open to the campus community.

cards.title: Collaborate at the Innovation Hub
cards.subtitle: Richey Mixon Building
cards.notes: Utilize the second-floor collaboration space for group projects, featuring comfortable couches and whiteboards in a high-energy makerspace.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated collaboration and community floor within the seven-story Sears think[box] innovation center.
cards.evidence_claim: Sears think[box] is a seven-story innovation center with a community floor and collaboration spaces.
cards.source_title: Sears think[box] | Case Western Reserve University
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; check website for specific floor hours and training requirements.

cards.title: Find a Home Base in Thwing
cards.subtitle: Thwing Center Lower Level
cards.notes: Socialize or study in this 'home-like' lounge featuring a kitchenette, game room, and TV area specifically for commuters.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated facility for off-campus students featuring study rooms and recreational amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Off Campus Student Lounge in Thwing Center offers a living room, game room, study room, and kitchenette for students residing off campus.
cards.access_notes: Requires a current CWRU ID for entry; located in the lower level of Hitchcock Hall.

cards.title: Group Study at Wade Commons
cards.subtitle: North Residential Village
cards.notes: Gather for group work in this large collaboration space equipped with tables and couches, conveniently located near North Village dining.
cards.short_summary: A popular collaboration room for North Residential Village students located within Wade Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pioneer Room inside Wade Commons offers a large collaboration space with table and couch seating.
cards.source_title: Best study spots on CWRU's campus
cards.access_notes: Primarily serves North Residential Village students; open during Wade Commons hours.

cards.title: Unwind at The Spot
cards.subtitle: Leutner Commons Lower Level
cards.notes: Head to the lower level of Leutner for a quiet retreat with couches and tables, often used for student events and late-night studying.
cards.short_summary: A versatile student gathering and event space located in the basement of Leutner Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: The Spot is located in the lower level of Leutner Commons and can seat up to 100 guests.
cards.access_notes: Open for general student use when not reserved for private events.

cards.title: Focus at the Harris Library
cards.subtitle: Mandel School, Room 175
cards.notes: Escape the main library crowds at this specialized social work library, offering a quiet environment and research assistance.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, specialized library within the Mandel School of Applied Social Sciences.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lillian and Milford Harris Library is located in Mandel School, room 175, and provides research help and study space.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday until 7 PM during the fall semester; check website for seasonal hours.

cards.title: Read in the Hart Crane Room
cards.subtitle: Thwing Center
cards.notes: Enjoy a 'homey' atmosphere for evening study sessions in this cozy reading room located within the central student union.
cards.short_summary: A comfortable, living-room style reading space located in the Thwing Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hart Crane Reading Room in Thwing Center is described as a homey and cozy place to get work done.
cards.access_notes: Open during Thwing Center operating hours; accessible to all students.

cards.title: Study at the Health Education Campus
cards.subtitle: Samson Pavilion, 4th Floor
cards.notes: Access modern lounges, kitchenettes, and lockers on the fourth floor of the Samson Pavilion, designed for health profession students.
cards.short_summary: Advanced study and lounge spaces for health sciences students located in the Samson Pavilion.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Learning Communities on the fourth floor of Samson Pavilion include kitchenettes, lockers, and space to lounge and study.
cards.source_title: Dining and Study Spaces | Health Education Campus
cards.access_notes: Priority access for students in health profession programs; requires CWRU ID for entry.

cards.title: Collaborate in the Nord Atrium
cards.subtitle: Case Quad
cards.notes: Use the scattered tables in the high-ceilinged atrium for group sessions, or find a quiet classroom on the upper levels for privacy.
cards.short_summary: A central, open-air study and collaboration space located in the heart of the engineering quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Nord Hall holds various classrooms and open spaces; the atrium has scattered tables great for group study sessions.
cards.source_title: Best study spots on CWRU's campus
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; typically accessible late for students with quad building access.
